div.div:
Protected organizer payout destination; simulator reference or encrypted sandbox profile.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
environment: text [NN]
default 'simulation'
provider: text [NN]
provider_reference: text [?]
encrypted_details: bytea [?]
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
verified_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, organization_id)
CK1: environment IN ('simulation','sandbox')
CK2: status IN ('pending','verified','rejected')
CK3: status <> 'verified' OR verified_at IS NOT NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(organization_id) -> organization(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Retained demo/sandbox identity decisions; no production KYC documents.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
submitted_by_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
reviewed_by_user_id: uuid [FK ?]
environment: text [NN]
default 'simulation'
status: text [NN]
default 'pending'
reviewed_at: timestamptz [?]
reason: text [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, organization_id)
CK1: environment IN ('simulation','sandbox')
CK2: status IN ('pending','approved','rejected')
CK3: status = 'pending' OR reviewed_at IS NOT NULL
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(organization_id) -> organization(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(submitted_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(reviewed_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Immutable evidence of event paid-terms acceptance.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
accepted_by_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
terms_version: text [NN]
terms_hash: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_id, terms_version, accepted_by_user_id)
UQ2: (id, event_id)
TRIGGER: reject UPDATE / DELETE (append-only).
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(accepted_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Event-level checklist and paid-sales gate.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK UQ NN]
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
payout_profile_id: uuid [FK ?]
verification_record_id: uuid [FK ?]
terms_acceptance_id: uuid [FK ?]
status: text [NN]
default 'incomplete'
activation_fee_minor: bigint [NN]
default 500000
currency: text [NN]
default 'KZT'
paid_attempt_id: uuid [FK UQ ?]
activated_at: timestamptz [?]
suspension_reason: text [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_id)
UQ2: (paid_attempt_id)
UQ3: (id, event_id)
CK1: status IN ('incomplete','pending','active','failed','suspended')
CK2: activation_fee_minor > 0 AND currency = 'KZT'
CK3: status <> 'active' OR (payout_profile_id IS NOT NULL AND verification_record_id IS
NOT NULL AND terms_acceptance_id IS NOT NULL AND paid_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND
activated_at IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id, organization_id) -> event(id, organization_id) [1 parent / 0..1 children]
(payout_profile_id, organization_id) -> payout_profile(id, organization_id) [0..1 parent
/ 0..* children]
(verification_record_id, organization_id) -> verification_record(id, organization_id)
[0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(terms_acceptance_id, event_id) -> terms_acceptance(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..1
children]
(paid_attempt_id, event_id) -> payment_attempt(id, event_id) [0..1 parent / 0..1
children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
